title: The lamp, unlit, December
logline: The green lamp on the drafting table in December, unlit, the room lit by the window's gray, a page on the table finished. Three months before it's lit on the beach. The last unlit page of the lamp.

panels.composition: A drafting table by a gray December window: a green swing-arm desk lamp unlit, a finished drawn page on the table, the room lit only by the window.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a drafting table beside a gray December window with an unlit green swing-arm desk lamp and a finished drawn page, the room lit only by the window, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The last unlit page of the lamp.
